title: NoMorePoppies
description: Removes Poppies From The Iron Golem Loot Table.
body:
# NoMorePoppies

Tired of Iron Golems cluttering your inventory with poppies every time you kill one? NoMorePoppies is a simple, lightweight resource pack that removes poppies from the Iron Golem loot table entirely.

![a double chest filled with iron](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d7d589aacabb931e75b2ca56ee5a8591c5e2d0a.png)

Iron Golems have been handing out poppies since forever, and while it's a cute lore touch, it gets old fast, especially when you're running a large iron farm and your hoppers are filling up with flowers you never asked for and definitely don't need.

## What It Does
No More Nice Golems makes one focused change and does it well. There's nothing to install, nothing to configure, and no performance impact whatsoever. Just drop it in your resource packs folder and your Iron Golems will finally mind their own business.

## Compatibility
- ✅ Works with most mod loaders: Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, or vanilla
- ✅ No dependencies required
- ✅ Compatible with all Iron Golem farms
- ✅ Safe to add or remove mid-world
